capabilities: remember the last cursor position in each file and restore it on reopen
jump back to the previous cursor position across files
jump forward again after going back
track jumps within a single long file as part of the history
add go-back and go-forward commands for hotkey assignment
extras: The cross-file history is in memory only and clears on restart; the per-file last position is saved to disk. No hotkeys are assigned by default.
problem: Obsidian's built-in navigate back/forward only re-opens the previous note, not the exact line or scroll position where you were working.
